correctness.rationale: The two-particle subdivision criterion holds (no loop shorter than three edges; paths between distinct essential vertices have at least one edge). The cubical chain sizes are 28, 144, 156 and the 1-skeleton is connected. Sending a moving-edge cell (e,w) to e, a vertex-pair {a,b} to a+b and every square to zero is an equivariant chain map to G. It surjects on H1: chordless cycles of this complete multipartite graph have length at most four, hence have a free vertex at which to leave the other particle, and chordless cycles generate the cycle space. Thus b1 is at least 17, giving rank(d2) at most 100 over Q. The independent reproduction finds rank(d2)=100 over F_1009, hence also over Q. It computes H2 traces directly on a free-coordinate basis of the modular kernel (not by the frozen checker’s Lefschetz-only method). Equality of the ranks and a unit maximal minor ensure reduction of the integral kernel is the computed kernel, and the finite-order integral traces have absolute value at most 56, so the modular lifts are unique. H1 is equivariantly isomorphic to graph H1, and its signed trace agrees with the independently alternating chain traces. All 20 class sizes and five trace columns agree exactly. After finite equivariant triangulation/subdivision, rational quotient chains give coinvariants, which are exact and coincide with invariants over Q. This applies to the cubical model and to X (one can triangulate the product with the diagonal as an invariant subcomplex and use the derived complement); the equivariant cubical inclusion induces the required homology isomorphism. The averages give (1,0,0), (1,0,2), (1,3,3). No claim is made about integral torsion.
residual_risks: Only rational homology and the specified action and quotient groups are checked.

value.rationale: The first nonplanar cross-polytope graph is a natural next case after the octahedron. The trace table determines the actual degree-one and degree-two rational representations, usable for other subgroup quotients without a new chain calculation. The two different proper subgroups retain different degrees of homology although the whole-group quotient is rationally acyclic. This is substantive beyond recalculating ranks or applying a symmetry name to them.
residual_risks: This is a natural finite datum, not a general theorem for all cross-polytope graphs or an integral classification.
